title: Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO Details
intro:
Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO is a book build issue of ₹650.00 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 0.32 crore shares aggregating to ₹95.00 crores and offer for sale of 1.85 crore shares aggregating to ₹555.00 crores.

Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 20, 2026 and will close on Aug 24, 2026. The allotment for the Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 25, 2026. Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 28, 2026.

Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO is set issue price band at ₹285 to ₹300 per share. The lot size for an application is 50 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹15,000 (50 shares) (based on upper price).

ICICI Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO RHP for detailed Information.

Incorporated in 1990, Tempsens Instruments (India) Limited a thermal engineering and specialised cable manufacturer, engaged in the design and manufacture of customized temperature sensing solutions, electrical heating solutions and specialised cables. Its product portfolio includes temperature sensing solutions, electrical heating solutions, and specialized cables.

They manufactures of contact and non-contact temperature sensors in India in terms of revenue with a market share of approximately 10.5% in temperature sensor segment during the year ended March 31, 202.6

From April 1, 2023 to March 31, 2026, the company has served more than 1,000 unique customer. It also export its products to more than 80 countries including United Arab Emirates, Germany and Poland penetrating markets across Asia Pacific, Africa & Middle East and North Africa, Europe, and North and South America.

faqs.question: How to apply in Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO will be done on Tuesday, August 25, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Aug 27, 2026 . Check the Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Aug 28, 2026 .
